# Code of Conduct

## Our standards

Please be respectful, constructive, and professional in issues and pull requests.

Examples of expected behavior:

- Be kind and patient
- Give actionable feedback
- Assume good intent

Examples of unacceptable behavior:

- Harassment or personal attacks
- Hate speech or discriminatory language
- Doxxing or sharing private information

## Enforcement

Maintainers may remove content and restrict participation for behavior that violates this code.

## Reporting

Report conduct concerns privately:

- Email: report@justagwas.com
